senders.body: Important senders stay protected until you opt them into automation.

empty.body: When Zero Mail detects important senders, they will appear here.
empty.title: No protected senders yet

senders.title: Protected senders

c1.body: Drafts land in Gmail's drafts folder. You read, edit, and hit send. There is no setting that lets the AI deliver mail on your behalf.
c1.title: No auto-send. Ever.

c2.body: Raw email bodies, LLM prompts, completions, and embeddings are discarded after each triage run. Only metadata and your audit log persist.
c2.title: Nothing is stored long-term.

c3.body: Bodies are stripped of attachments, signatures, and quoted history, then truncated to a token budget before any model call.
c3.title: Sanitized before AI sees it.

c4.body: Pause triage with one click. Undo any archive, label, or draft from a complete audit trail going back 90 days.
c4.title: Every action is reversible.

trust.desc: Auto-triage only works if you can fully trust it with a real inbox. We engineered Zero Mail around three hard guarantees — and made every one of them auditable.

p1.body: Zero Mail never sends a message on your behalf. Replies sit in your Gmail Drafts folder until you press Send.
p1.title: Drafts only — never auto-send

p2.body: Your messages stay in Gmail. We process them in memory to apply your rules, then keep only the headers and an action log.
p2.title: We don't store email bodies

p3.body: Disconnect from inside Zero Mail or directly from your Google Account. We delete your data within 24 hours.
p3.title: Revoke access anytime

title.b: don't hand the send button to AI.
